fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/ListingPages/Bs6Trucks.cy.js#ListingPages - NewListingPages [bs6Trucks] [en] — BS6 Trucks TC-NLP-06: Check Offers lead form shows required validation when submitted empty on BS6 Trucks
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-NLP-06
**Title:** Check Offers lead form shows required validation when submitted empty on BS6 Trucks
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open the BS6 Trucks listing page, open Check Offers, and submit with name, mobile and city all left empty.

**Expected Result:**
The real, page-shown validation messages for name, mobile and location are displayed, and no lead is submitted.

**Steps:**
1. Open the BS6 Trucks listing page
2. Click Check Offers to open its lead form
3. Leave name, mobile and city empty and submit
4. Verify all three required-field validation messages are shown
